content: Tuwa Bayaura ge mene ewowora ge daigatinoiya.
Farisayo ena aune sao tauyao ge gipao emo ena Yerusalem atu bumuwa amimene Yesura-una augaiwa.
Augairo buro-mani nuna mene wawong oko sayao nona mininewa awiya gigiwa.

Wawong sayaora tani auna susuwa eyao era: Farisayo emo gege okowata, Yuda emo apakana dema, awong nona teba oko mininowa. Awong ewowo nunae-una sao tauyao ge awiya ago yero wawong saero aune nona mininowa ara.
Awong maketra atu nema kapetegairo gare buro gitau ou suwero aune ago nona mininowa. Awong ewowora sao tauyao ge ewe-pape ago nasani awangne taore aure sainowa.
Arare Farisayo aune sao tauyao ge gipao emo amimene Yesu eyero atata yero sewa, “Buro-mani nina mene nono yero ewowora sao tauyao ge awiya doro wawong oko sayao nona tebeba mininei?”
Ayero sewa nung awong eno eyero sena, “Niye ge iwao emo me sao yero nowa. Ge porofete Yesaya mene gaena amimene niye gapuniya. Ge gaena awiya eyero mitiya era:

content.text: Emo bauno emimene na begiti mene bowi yero nowa, arata moko nunae nana-una oko mitiya.
Awong emora ge awiya Tuwa Bayaura sao tauyao ge ine ayero sero gipero ayero nowa. Arare awong na bowi yari yero tetere yero nowa.

content: Yesaya mene ayero gaena ara.”
Yesu mene ayero sero aune ge susuuno eyero sena, “Niye Tuwa Bayaura sao tauyao ge doro emora wini ge puro iniro baingtitinowa.” Ayero sena arauwa.
Yesu mene ge zo nupema awong eno eyero sena, “Niye Tuwa Bayaura sao tauyao ge doro ewowora tani ago yero nowa, awiya kotupunowa iwaing noi?
Na ayero sinena, noeno okowata, Mose mene eyero sena,

content.text: Ning tani iwaing ai maung nina eno nasani neu.

content: Nupema,

content.text: Zo nung ai maung nuna eno ge meko sariniya,

content: Mose mene ayero sena, arata niye eyero sinowa: Zo nung ai maung nuna eno eyero sai teng yariniya, ‘Na nona nito eno pugatena, arata na nona awiya mena Koban eno sewang.’ (Koban auna susuwa eyao era: “Na nona ewiya Tuwa Bayau eno pugari sewang tauyena.”)
Mani zo ayero sariniya, awiya niye nung ai maung soremoiye sero awang sinowa.
Ayero yero niye Tuwa Bayaura sao tauyao ge pu ago gairo ewowora tani pu gitau gairo mani eno gipinowa. Tani ayao awiya daigairo yero nowa.” Ayero sena arauwa.
Nona dubora beingti tapunoiya auna ge.
Yesu mene ayero sero emo bauno nupema yausenu bumuwa eyero sena, “Ge sana nigipu. Niye apakana nigiro baingtipu.
Nona be ninae-una toitinoiya amimene oko niye noi beingtire yero nowa. Ge be ninae-una atu kasa noiya amimene niye noi beingtire yero nowa ara.
[Zo nung dawongne mene ge ewiya nigaise.]” Ayero sena arauwa.
Ayero sero emo bauno doro buro-maine dema gare toiro buro-mani mene ge sena auna susuwa nigari sero nung atata yewa ara.
Atata yewa giro nung awong eno eyero sena, “Ayero niye dema oko gao yero neita? Niye susuwa ewiya gosineita? Nona minao mene bera toiro niye oko noi beingtire yero nowa.

Noeno okowata, nona minao amimene dubo ninae-una oko toitinoiya. Nona awiya tini ninae-una baungno nagibo nuna-una wowosinoiya.” Yesu mene ge awiya sinasani nona minao apakana amimene dubora beingti oko tapunoiya. Ayero sena ara.
Ayero sero aune eyero sena, “Tani emora-una dubora atu kasa yero noiya amimene emo awiya noi beingtire yero noiya.
Noeno okowata, emora-una mokora atu, o emora-una dubora atu kotumao meko mene kasa yero nowa — kuma yao, ugaing yao, mani dao magayao, atao gerayao,
dubo-dubo yao, tani meko yao, ge iwao ge sao, gao meko yao, isi patao ge sao, taung puro witao, wini ge dero nao —
tani awiya apakana emora-una mokora atu kasa yero emo awiya yero noi beingtire yero noiya.” Ayero sena arauwa.
Bauno Yuda oko zo mene Yesu tumo diro baingtina.

Yesu mene atu iropuro baung tawing zora atu napo zo yazo nuna Taya mitauna auna yero garo zora toiro mitasani emo bauno mene nung atu mitina awiya gowi sero awang sena, arata nung nutope pungyaine yao teng oko.
Ayero nenu bauno zo mene Yesura bowi nigina. Bauno auna mani bauno di zo maingkoka amimene iwae nuna-una mokora mitauna ara. Bauno amimene kasa ye Yesura-una gairo koing gaina.
Arata bauno awiya nung Yuda oko. Tawing nuna yazo Sirofonisia. Arare nung Yesu eno isa sero nung mani nuna-una iwae tunaise senu
Yesu mene nung eno ge eniya zo eyero sena, “Na nona mani mamani eno gitau pugana minaya teng yae. Noeno okowata, mani mamanina nona minao sorero sino unao ine awiya teng oko yariniya.”
Ayero senu giro bauno mene ge eniya auna abena eyero sena, “Tuwa, awiya meba sinesa. Arata sino opesa wese atu mitasani susuna mani mene nowa wowosinoiya awiya mininowa.”
Ayero senu giro Yesu mene nung eno eyero sena, “Ge iwaing sesesa, arare gare baung. Iwae mene mani nina mena doro babiya.” Ayero sena ara.
Ayero senu bauno mene nupema tera kapete nuna-una gare gairo baungno iwae mena baungnu mani nuna teba apegairo mitina awiya gigina.
Yesu mene emo zo dawong itigao awiya kora yena.
Yesu mene atu iropuro tawing napo Taya mitina awiya doro napo Saidon buwagairo tawing yazo Dekapolis awiya buwagairo kasa ye ou nazi zo yazo Galilaya auna gaina.
Ayero mitinu emo ena mene emo zo puro buro Yesura-una yewa ara. Emo awiya dawong itigao, ge aung. Emo mene emo awiya puro Yesu mene nung ding yero kora yaise sero isa sewa.
Ayero yewa giro Yesu mene emo awiya puro emo bauno doro baungno dopero wawong soro emo auna-una daweng pugairo begura pisero wawong mene emo auna ewawa dingyero
diti ika uritira yero oweno tauyao pisero emo aeno eyero sena, “Epata.” (Ge naname-una, “Dawong iwaise.”)
Ayero senu dawong tangsenu be eo yenu ge iwaing sena ara.
Ayero yenu giro Yesu mene awong eno eyero sena, “Niye tani euna bowi sowi sero awang sinena.” Ayero sinaunata emo bauno mene gewera yero keregairo nauwa.

Anauwa emo bauno ena mene nigiro wawong di gauno yangka sero eyero sinauwa, “Nung tani apakana iwaing yero noiya. Nung noi emo dawong itigao mene ge nupema nigitinowa, nupema emo ge aung amimene ge nupema sinowa.” Ayero sinauwa arauwa.
